decisions.reason: As an articulated construction dumper that extends our established construction-machinery know-how and service infrastructure, it remains a product we can improve and support efficiently.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle stays relatively far from our core knowledge base and shows no comparably strong market-validation signal, we would reallocate the tied-up development and support resources.
The material lift line is close to our established offer and the reported major order confirms demand that we can readily exploit with our existing engineering, logistics and service capabilities.

Although the compact underground mining loader is more distant from our traditional range, its very strong early operating data provides exactly the field feedback our own R&D can absorb to refine and commercialize it further.
